description: Defines a class 'Folder_DocumentLoaders' implementing 'INode' to load and process documents from a folder, supporting various file types and options.

classes.name: Folder_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class to load documents from a specified folder with support for multiple file types and options.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Folder_DocumentLoaders instance with configuration for loading documents.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously loads documents from the specified folder, applies optional text splitting and metadata processing, and returns either document objects or concatenated text.
